numerator: league scoring settings x nflverse stats (scoring_stat_map)
notes: Approximations documented in docs/METRICS.md; reconciled against observed with tolerance.

numerator: started kicker points
notes: Realized outcomes only. Waiver-availability reconstruction and counterfactuals are later work.

numerator: current league scoring x ffverse expected stats (pass/rush/receive)
notes: ffopportunity model; kicking and fumbles not modelled so K expected points are NULL. diff = actual - expected.

numerator: fantasy points (current scoring) scored by opposing players at a position
notes: rank 1 = allows the most. Regular season only.

numerator: weeks' head-to-head wins vs every other roster
notes: expected_wins = games x all-play win%; luck_wins = actual - expected.

numerator: best lineup from rostered players' observed points (greedy: fixed slots then flex)
notes: Verified equal to Sleeper potential points (ppts) over regular-season weeks. bench_points_left = optimal - started.

numerator: sum of season ppg over top-N rostered players at a position (N = starting slots)
notes: Uses current rosters and season-to-date ppg; changes as rosters change.

numerator: PFR targets/completions/yards/TD/passer rating allowed when the defender was targeted
notes: Context only: public data does not record who covered whom.

numerator: last-3 share minus season share
notes: Meaningless before 4 games (L3 equals season).

numerator: sum of metric numerator over the player's last 3 played regular-season games
denominator: sum of metric denominator over the same 3 games (per-game metrics: games)
notes: Rate of sums (not mean of rates). Window is the player's own last 3 appearances; bye/DNP weeks do not count. Metric list and thresholds in seeds/trend_metrics.csv.

numerator: sum of metric numerator over played games before the last 3
denominator: sum of metric denominator over the same games
notes: NULL when the player has fewer than 4 games.

numerator: trend_value_l3 minus trend_value_prior
notes: Compared against min_change in trend_metrics.csv (e.g. 0.03 target share; 2 expected points).

numerator: mean per-game value in last 3 minus mean per-game value before
denominator: sd of the player's per-game values times sqrt(1/3 + 1/n_prior)
notes: Welch-style two-sample statistic using the player's own game-to-game noise. Strength: 1 = beyond noise; 2 = clear change. NULL when sd is 0 or n_prior < 1.

numerator: up when change >= min_change and z >= 1 (down symmetrically); flat otherwise; insufficient below 4 games
notes: Both bars must clear: a practical minimum and a statistical one. confidence = strong (|z|>=2) / moderate (>=1) / weak.

numerator: average of trend_z over opportunity metrics with a direction call (targets/game; target share; air-yard share; carries/game; carry share; snap share; expected points; pass attempts for QB)
notes: Deliberately excludes fantasy points and aDOT. opportunity_trend = rising (>=1) / falling (<=-1) / steady / insufficient.

numerator: points allowed to a position over the defense's last 3 games minus points allowed before (same z construction as trend_z)
notes: softer = allowing more lately (change >= 3 points and z >= 1); stiffer symmetric. Regular season; current scoring.

numerator: pass attempts (excluding spikes) + sacks + scrambles on real plays
notes: From play-by-play (fct_play.is_dropback). Excludes no-play/nullified rows kneels spikes and two-point tries. Replaces dropbacks_excl_scrambles where pbp exists; the old column is kept.

numerator: pass attempt to an identified receiver on a real play excluding two-point tries
notes: Reconciles exactly with nflverse weekly targets (2025: 0 of 4533 player-weeks differ). Two-point targets are flagged separately (is_two_point_target) and never counted.

numerator: player targets whose FTN read_thrown is first read
denominator: team targets whose read_thrown is first read over the player's appearance games
notes: FTN charting 2022+ via nflverse (CC-BY-SA 4.0). read_thrown '1' = first read (data-verified; the dictionary's '0' is the uncharted/non-throw fill). Designed throws (DES) checkdowns (CHK) scramble drill (SD) and later reads (2) are separate counts. NULL before 2022 and on zero denominators. charting_coverage = team charted targets / team targets travels with it; uncharted is never assumed first read.

numerator: player first-read targets
notes: A different question from first-read share (share of the player's own targets that were first reads). Published separately as the spec requires.

numerator: dropbacks (is_dropback) the player was on the field for per participation data
notes: PROXY. Receiving positions (WR/TE/RB/FB/HB) only. Presence is not a route: blocking TEs and chip-release backs inflate it ~10-15% vs charting services (Chase 2024: 705 vs ~615). NULL (unknown) when the game has no participation row. Participation files publish after each postseason so the current season has none.

numerator: routes_proxy
denominator: team dropbacks with participation data over the same games
notes: How often the player is on the field when the QB drops back. Passing-down analogue of snap share.

numerator: targets in participation-covered games
notes: Lower bound on true targets per route run because the denominator is inflated. Compare players to each other not to published TPRR.

numerator: receiving yards in participation-covered games
notes: Lower bound on true yards per route run (same reason).

numerator: provider route count from raw.routes_feed
notes: Licensed feed via `league-lab import-routes` (CSV contract in ingest/routes_feed.py). Identity through player_id_map. targets_per_route_run / yards_per_route_run use it; NULL until a file is imported.

numerator: player targets / carries / routes_proxy / first-read targets inside a situation bucket
denominator: team totals in the same bucket over the player's appearance games
notes: Buckets: half (H1/H2/OT) pre-snap score state (trailing 9+ / 1-8 / tied / leading 1-8 / 9+) down-and-distance field zone and QB on the play (dropbacks). Score state is pre-play from the offense's perspective; raw score kept in fct_play. Halves sum to season totals (test).

numerator: targets inside the opponent 20
denominator: team targets inside the 20 over the same games
notes: From play-by-play; carries version is red_zone_carry_share.

numerator: player form / usage / opponent / Vegas / injury as of the games before the week
notes: mart_player_week_features. As-of only: a week-N row sees games < N (test assert_features_never_peek). Universe = rostered QB/RB/WR/TE whose team plays; upcoming weeks use the latest published roster.

numerator: intercept + sum(weight x feature) per position (seed ranking_weights.csv fitted by OLS on 2019-2022)
notes: Transparent baseline. Features: xPPG L5; PPG season / L3 / previous season with a 6-game fade; opponent allowed vs league average; implied team total; home; L3-vs-season target/carry share; L3 snap share. Applied identically in SQL (test assert_rankings_apply_seed_formula). Ranks exclude Out / Doubtful / IR.

numerator: Spearman rank correlation / top-N hit rate / MAE of a scorer vs actual points
denominator: per season-week-position on players who played
notes: `league-lab backtest` on held-out seasons (weights never saw them). Naive scorers: season PPG; last-3 PPG; xPPG L5. 2023-2025: baseline beats every naive scorer at every position (Spearman +0.03 to +0.05).

numerator: touchdown plays with yards_gained >= 40 (>= 50) by the passer / rusher / receiver on the play (fct_play)
notes: Behind Sleeper's pass_td_40p / rush_td_40p / rec_td_40p (and *_50p) bonus keys. Laterals credit the first receiver. 0 when the game has no play-by-play loaded (never NULL: the keys come from plays and plays are loaded for every season).

numerator: 1 when low <= yards < high for the game (bonus_pass_yd_300 = 300-399; bonus_rec_yd_100 = 100-199; _200 / _400 = open-ended)
notes: Sleeper's buckets are exclusive: a 210-yard game pays the 200+ bonus only. Applied in points_current_scoring and points_recomputed; left out of expected points on purpose (a threshold on an expectation is not an expectation).

numerator: gradient-boosted projection per stat-line component (targets/receptions/yards/TDs/carries/attempts/INTs/fumbles) from as-of features
notes: Priced per league with the scoring map (stat keys + yardage bonuses). Walk-forward validated 2021-2025. Only in-season-available features (no routes proxy).

numerator: P10 / P90 = projection + quantile regressors of the out-of-fold miss around the priced line; split-conformal widening measured on the newest training season
notes: Board ranks by proj_points. coverage_80 in mart_projection_backtest says how often the actual landed inside; target 0.80.

numerator: the partner's gain over the window (their best lineup after the trade minus before; weeks of the window) mapped to 0-100 through (-6 -> 0; 0 -> 25; 2 -> 50; 6 -> 75; 12 -> 100) with the labels No deal (< 0.05) / Maybe (< 2) / Likely (2-6) / Hard to say no (> 6)
grain: league x trade package x window
notes: Wave I-A (IA-2): the trade calculator's dial. By our projection only; the caption says so. METRICS § "Trade interest and the sanity bound".

numerator: mean(actual - projected) per position x projected-rank bucket (top 6 / 7-12 / 13-24 / 25+) or decile; walk-forward out-of-fold rows (ops.calibration_oof)
grain: league scoring x position x bucket x season
notes: Wave I-A (M1): the diagnosis of the top of the distribution. No star penalty found; the WR fringe is projected too high. The two-piece calibration map (cal1.0) stays off (LEAGUE_LAB_PROJECTION_CALIBRATION). METRICS § "Calibration of the top".

numerator: Sleeper's latest projected stat line per player-week (raw.sleeper_projections -> mart_market_line) priced in the league's scoring with compute_points
grain: season x week x gsis_id (league-free; priced per league on request)
notes: Wave I-A (IA-3): "Sleeper has him at 16.2" on the rankings / the card / My Week, and the trade finder's sanity bound (b). Empty for a week whose snapshot was never fetched before its kickoff (the nightly fetches the next week to kick off).

numerator: points x P(stat in band | projected mean) for flat bonuses and whole-10 steps; TDs x E[share of TDs in the distance band] for touchdowns by distance
notes: Wave I-C (M2 + IC-1): scoring_ev's curves (gamma for rushing / receiving yards and receptions, normal for passing yards) and TD-distance shares from fct_play 2019-2025 (seed scoring_distributions). Always on for MFL specs (no nightly to agree with); Sleeper leagues behind LEAGUE_LAB_EV_PRICING, off until the nightly prices with the same engine so every screen agrees (next: v3.1). METRICS § "Expected-value pricing".

numerator: max of (lineup loss over the horizon; depth lost = margin over the best free agent at the position x the position's absence rate; starts after the horizon above a replacement; season points above the best free agent; a role scenario's upside) — never their sum
notes: Wave I-F (IF-1, the decision-quality review § Priority 2): the drop a claim costs; the best drop per add is the cheapest, the incumbent first on a tie; net gain = lineup gain - (cost - lineup loss); a claim is worthwhile at net >= 1 this week or >= 3 over the horizon. METRICS § "Drop cost".

numerator: the trade's starter-point gain over the window minus the best alternative's (standing pat = 0; the best legal waiver move's net gain)
grain: league x roster x trade x window
notes: Wave I-F (IF-2, § Priority 3): the finder ranks by it; a trade below the waiver move is demoted and keeps a reason only when the numbers give one (this week's gain, season value above replacement, the bench). METRICS § "Against the alternatives".

numerator: the opponent's expected corners (the depth chart as of the game) against the corners who played most of its coverage snaps this season; missing = a regular who cannot play (the availability overlay) or is no longer listed
notes: Wave I-F (IF-3, § Priority 1): the implication (less representative / stands / unknown) and the forecast's treatment (contextual only: the projection carries no opponent personnel); a changed defense's matchup rank never breaks a coin flip. METRICS § Matchups "Current personnel".

numerator: our recorded lineup's points (the lineup the app would have started, Sleeper's points per starter) minus the submitted lineup's points
notes: Wave I-G, V-1: ops.lineup_record (frozen at the week's first kickoff; weeks 1-4 of 2026 rebuilt from the frozen projections, labelled reconstructed) graded by mart_decision_record; a K/DEF with no number makes the lineup unknown (NULL, left out of the sums); About's record block, the console's Record page

numerator: the hindsight optimum's points (ops.lineup_totals is_realised) minus the submitted lineup's points
notes: Wave I-G, V-1: what a perfect lineup would have added; summed per league-week and season to date
